dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a smooth spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a broad pixel radius, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly slanted at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The base of the fin is approximately 1.6 times the vertical height from the dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curvature with a medium pixel radius creating a prominent, bulbous melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick pixel width relative to length, extending anteriorly from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform luminescent cyan coloration across the entire visible integument, masking standard pigmentation patterns.
